subject: Good car for stunt runs.
author: Xandu
body:
I prefer the Watson Burnout Roadster for stunt runs. It is one of the slower stunt run cars. It handles good which is a good thing since it means that you will crash less. I normally end my Stunt Runs around 2,5 million points with this car. By end I mean that I let it timeout.😃

Barrel Rolls are risky business (2x multiplier) and I crash 2/5 times. To get high scores I do them only when Im sure that I will not crash (going of cliffs or big ramps).
